name: art_d69
title: Card scene candidates, batch 9
intro: Pick one scene for each card, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, the event and the building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Nothing is selected to start. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b9/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Power Purchase Agreement
rows.note: Power. Each tile is the scene over Power Purchase Agreement and Microgrid Lab Compact. 1. A power-company engineer in an amber hard hat and a research-station director in a field jacket shaking hands over a signed blank contract laid on the hood of a utility truck, a crew behind them unspooling a thick new cable from a small substation across a meadow to a domed research station; no flags, logos or emblems. 2. Two negotiators at a folding table set out in the grass beneath a row of wind turbines, one sliding a signed blank contract across to the other, a single amber cable running from the nearest turbine past the table to a domed research station on the next rise, crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes waiting at its door; no flags, logos or emblems. 3. At the gate of a domed research station, a utility clerk handing a large brass power meter and a rolled blank contract to a smiling scientist, a line of fresh wooden poles carrying new wire back over the hills to a distant power plant; no flags, logos or emblems.

rows.label: 2. Microgrid Lab Compact
rows.note: Power. Each tile is the scene over Power Purchase Agreement and Microgrid Lab Compact. 1. A self-powered research campus in a green valley, low white laboratories set around a central yard of battery cabinets and a small control hut, two wind turbines on the slope and a little river-turbine house on the stream feeding it, an engineer checking a panel of amber lamps while scientists wheel crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes between the labs; no solar panels, no flags, logos or emblems. 2. Inside a bright research campus's own power control room, a tall window looking out over its battery yard, wind turbines and white lab buildings, an engineer pulling a large lever as a row of amber lamps lights up on a hand-drawn map of the campus grid, a scientist alongside holding a glowing sky-blue research cube; no solar panels, no flags, logos or emblems. 3. A small research lab campus on a rocky island running on its own grid, tidal turbines churning in the channel, a stone battery house and a few wind turbines on the cliffs, cables climbing to a domed research station on the headland where scientists unload crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes from a boat; no solar panels, no flags, logos or emblems.
